Commentary.Commentary: Once again the West Indian spinners, Sunil Narine and Samuel Badree were very miser in their spells. Afghanistan batted cautiously to not give away many wickets to this pair. The most successful bowler on show was Kesrick Williams, claiming a 3-fer, but he was a bit expensive as well. West Indies will back themselves to chase this down. But they cannot take it lightly. Let's see how they approach. Do join us in a short while.

Mohammad Nabi fared well in the middle overs to keep the innings together and his knock allowed Afghanistan to reach a total with which they can fight. Shafiqullah Shafiq also added handy runs towards the end.

By far the best batting performance by Afghanistan but that has come in a dead rubber. Sigh. It cannot be called a fluent and clinical piece of batting but they have done well to post a challenging total on the board. Noor Ali Zadran provided a brisk start up front and was the only shining star in the top order. But the way he threw away his wicket was very disappointing.
Full ball on the stumps, Naib drives it to long on for a run. AFGHANISTAN FINISH ON 146/6.
Naib backs away, Taylor bowls it full outside off and the batsman fails to get bat on it.
SIX! SMASHED! Full ball on leg stump, Naib hits it over deep square leg for a maximum. Just what the visitors wanted.
BOUNCER! A well-directed bouncer. Naib does well to duck under it.
Bouncer outside off, Naib tries to drag it on the leg side but does not connect.
Full toss outside off, Zadran hits it straight down the ground for a run.
Gulbadin Naib strides out to the middle.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Shafiqullah is walking back to the hut. Short of a length ball on the stumps. Shafiqullah goes for the heave over the leg side but misses it and it shatters the stumps. A good innings by Shafiqullah here comes to an end.
FOUR! SHOT! Full ball on the stumps, Shafiqullah hits it to the mid-wicket fence for a boundary. Expensive over here by Williams.
FOUR! EDGED! Full ball outside off, Shafiqullah slashes at it but gets an outside edge and the ball races to the third man fence. 12 runs off the first 4 balls.
SIX! THAT'S HUGE! Full ball on off stump, Shafiqullah just smashes it over mid-wicket for a biggie. That went a long way.
Short ball, pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Short ball, Shafiqullah tries to pull it but the bounce gets big on him, gets a top edge and goes to mid on for a run.
FOUR! POOR LINE! Bowls it on the pads, Zadran tickles it fine and the ball races away for a boundary. Finishes the over with a boundary.
Very full on the pads, Zadran plays it with soft hands through mid-wicket and they run two.
Flat ball on the pads, Shafiqullah goes for the flick but misses it. The ball hits the pads and rolls onto the leg side for a leg bye.
Plays the ball on off stump to the off side for a run at point.
BEATEN! Tosses it up, gets a little turn. Zadran pokes at it and gets beaten.
Flatter ball, spinning away, Zadran defends it off the back foot.
Shortish ball outside off, dabbed down towards point for a run.
Runs in from around the wicket for the left-hander and serves it on a length outside off, Zadran pushes inside the line but it curls away to beat the outside edge.
Shortish and it's pulled down to long leg for a single.
FOUR! Taylor misses the yorker mark and serves a low dipping full toss on middle, Shafiqullah generates good power with his bottom hand as he muscles it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Najibullah Zadran walks in next.

OUT! That's a good catch by Lewis! A full length ball on off, Janat winds up for a big shot probably down the ground or over mid-wicket but it catches the top edge and balloons to third man. Evin Lewis in the deep misjudges it initially but then recovers quickly to take the catch with a forward dive. Good effort, these catches are never easy.
Short in length outside off, the batsman backs away to play at it but ends up pushing it back towards the bowler.
Full ball on the stumps, Janat drives it to long on for a run.
Bowled on the pads, Shafiqullah tickles it fine, Taylor runs in from backward square leg and cuts it off and they run three.
Shuffles across and the ball spins in to go off the inside part of the bat to mid-wicket.
Flatter ball outside off, Janat taps it down to short third man for a run.
Bowled on the stumps, Shafiqullah tucks it on the leg side for a run.
Lands it outside off, Shafiqullah gets down to sweep but does not make contact with the ball.
Five wides! Bowls it down the leg side, Shafiqullah goes for the sweep but misses the ball, the keeper fails to collect it and the ball goes through for a boundary. The umpire also signals wide.

Short ball on the stumps, Shafiqullah pulls it to square leg for a run. Rovman Powell runs across from deep backward square and overruns the ball but adjusts well to stick the right hand out and stop it cleanly.
Good length ball, angling in, does not make contact on the attempted tuck as the ball hits him around the hip region.
Length ball outside off, Shafiqullah goes for the heave but misses it completely.

OUT! One shot too many. Slower short ball, Nabi shuffles and goes to pull it but does not get the power he wanted. Finds Powell at backward square leg who takes an easy catch. Afghanistan lose their fourth.
FOUR! POOR LINE! Short ball outside off, Nabi cuts it hard through point for another boundary. He is on a roll here.
SIX! BANG! There she goes. Slower ball outside off, Nabi waits for it and hits it with all his power over the long on fence for a maximum. He is really striking it big.
Kesrick Williams is brought back into the attack.
Bowled on the stumps, punched between long on and mid-wicket for a run.
Flat length ball, spins in slightly to take the inside edge of the bat and goes away behind square on the leg side. The batsmen  get through for a single.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Spinning in on leg, tries to get the front leg out and feebly pull it fine but does not make great contact and is struck on the pads.
Length ball, not full enough for the sweep but he gets down and dispatches it very fine. Jerome Taylor sprints to his right from backward square leg and does well to cut it off. They run two.
Bowled on the stumps, Janat shuffles across and punches it down to long on for a run.
Full ball on the stumps, Nabi clips it wide of long on and they run two.
Very full ball, pushed back to the bowler off the leading edge.
FOUR! WHAT A SHOT! Short ball outside off, Nabi pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. That was hit really hard by Nabi. 12 off the first four balls.

Just short of Lendl Simmons at sweeper cover. Very full ball outside off, lofts it over the infield and the ball goes to the right of Simmons who runs across, gets behind the line of the ball and slides forward but the ball lands short of him. Good effort.
SIX! SMASHED! Full ball on the stumps, Nabi hits straight over the bowler's head for a maximum. That was hit with some power.
Back of a length ball outside off, Nabi goes for the heave on the leg side but misses it.
Bowled on the pads, Nabi flicks it to the leg side for a run.
Presses forward and tries to drive it through the off side but the ball goes off the inside part of the bat and misses the stumps. Went at it with a big gap between bat and pad.
Flat and back of a length, punched from the crease to the leg side.
Slightly fuller, Janat bends down and drives it to long on for a run.
Flatter and shorter on off, Janat drives it to cover.
Bowled outside off, Nabi plays it to the point region for a run.
Sunil Narine comes on to bowl.
Length ball on the stumps, Janat flicks it to square leg.
Short ball on the leg stump, Janat goes for the pull but misses it and it goes through to the keeper. Lucky not to be called a wide.
Short of a length, defended with an open bat face towards covers.
A tad full on the stumps, Nabi drives it down to long on for a run.
Length ball outside off, Nabi pushes it off the back foot to covers.
Length ball on the stumps, Janat drives it down the ground to long on for a run.
Drags his length back outside off, Janat punches it behind point for a run.
Tosses it outside off, Janat plays it off the front foot.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
Bowled on the stumps, Janat defends it on the front foot.
Quicker on the pads, Nabi works it to square leg for a run.
Bowls it on off stump, gets a little turn. Nabi tries to push it on the off side but gets beaten.
Bowled on the stumps, Nabi plays it to mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Full ball on off, Janat drives it straight down the ground for a single towards long on.
Karim Janat strides out to the middle.

OUT! There goes the captain. Powell gets his maiden international wicket. Length ball outside off, Stanikzai tries to drag it over mid-wicket but does not get the desired elevation he wanted. Hits it straight to Williams at mid-wicket who takes an easy catch.
Full ball on off stump, Nabi drives it down the ground for a run at long off.
Full ball on the pads of the batsman, Stanikzai flicks it to square leg for a run.
Rovman Powell comes in to the attack.
Quietly nudges it behind square and steals a single to end a tidy over, 4 from it.
Wide! Skidding down the leg side, Stanikzai fails to sweep and the keeper does well to collect it by moving across to his left. The bowler appeals for a catch but nothing from the umpire.
Flighted ball, Stanikzai runs down the track and defends.
Drops it short and outside off, Asghar cuts it through the line but finds the point fielder.
Shortish and in the line of the stumps, punched back past the bowler for a single.
Flighted full ball on middle, Nabi inside edges his attempted drive to mid-wicket. Right where the fielder came before this ball.
Sunil Narine comes in at mid-wicket.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Samuel Badree is brought back in to the attack.
Short ball outside off, Stanikzai pulls it to the mid-wicket region for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Back of a length ball, the batsman makes room and pushes it to point.
Slower ball outside off, Stanikzai waits and pushes it to point.
Strays on the pads, Nabi flicks it to square leg for a run.
Drifts down the pads, Stanikzai plays it on the leg side for a run.
Back of a length ball on off, Nabi plays it to the point region. Good Powerplay for Afghanistan.
BIG APPEAL! Bowls it down the leg side, Nabi goes for a flick but misses it. The ball brushes his pads and is taken by the keeper. They all appeal but the umpire gives it not out.
Short of a length outside off, Nabi plays it behind point and they run two.
Length ball outside off, the batsman guides it down to third man for a run.
Slower length ball, outside off, not picked by Stanikzai who swings early and gets beaten.
Length ball on the stumps, the batsman defends it from within the crease.
Carlos Brathwaite comes into the attack.
Mohammad Nabi comes out to bat.

OUT! WHAT HAVE YOU DONE THERE? Length ball on the stumps, Noor Ali moves way outside the off stump too early and completely misses it. It rattles the stumps and second wicket for the Windies. Really poor from Zadran!
Length ball, angling in, tries to tuck it fine but the ball goes off the pads instead and they run a leg bye.
Bowls it on a length on off, Asghar defends it on the front foot.
FOUR! POOR LINE! Short ball outside off, Stanikzai cuts it past point for a boundary.
Length ball on off, the batsman plays it to the point region.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Kesrick Williams comes on to bowl.
FOUR! GOOD BATTING! Full ball on the stumps, Zadran goes down on one knee and sweeps it behind square leg for a boundary. Two good overs here for Afghanistan.
Quicker ball on the stumps, the batsman pushes it off the back foot.
SIX! SHOT! Flighted delivery on off, Zadran comes down the track and hits the ball over the long off fence for a maximum. Looks in good touch here, Noor Ali!
Bowls it on the pads, the batsman flicks it to square leg for a run.
Around off, Asghar comes down to the pitch of the ball and hits it through mid-wicket for a couple.

Physio comes out! Asghar Stanikzai is down in serious pain. It appears he has seriously hurt the shin area of his left leg. Struggling to walk at the moment. Magic spray is out. Hopefully, he is fine to continue.

OUCH! The batsman is hurt here. Let me tell you, how? It's a full ball on off, Stanikzai advances down the track for a big shot but gets a massive inside edge on the unprotected area near his shin. He is down in terrible pain. Oh dear.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Length ball, angling across outside off. Zadran defends it from the crease.
FOUR! Third boundary of the over! Drifts on the pads of the batsman. Zadran tickles it fine and the ball races away to the fine leg fence.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Zadran. Full on the pads, Zadran flicks it through square leg for a boundary.
FOUR! POOR LINE! Full ball outside off, the batsman lofts it through point for a boundary.
Length ball, Zadran plays it to the point region.
WIDE! Bowled a high full toss down the leg side and the umpire signals a wide. The bowler apologizes.
Bowled on middle, the batsman defended it off the front foot.
Asghar Stanikzai walks in next.

OUT! Badree gets the first wicket of the day. Quicker ball on middle, Ahmadi goes down on one knee and tries to sweep it but misses it. They go up for an appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Badree gets his 50th wicket in T20Is for the Windies.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.
SIX! BANG! Zadran backs away a little, Badree follows him and he lofts it over long on for the first maximum of the day.
The batsman comes down the track and defends the ball on off stump off the front foot.

Big appeal for LBW but the umpire is not interested. Flatter ball on middle stump, the batsman goes to defend it off the front foot but gets beaten. The bowler appeals but the umpire gives it not out. The ball rolls to fine leg and they run through for a leg bye.
Samuel Badree to bowl from the other end.
FOUR! First boundary of the day! Full ball outside off, Zadran goes aerial and powers it over covers for a boundary.
Short on the body of the batsman, Zadran pulls it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Full ball, angling away outside off. Zadran goes for a heave on the leg side but does not connect.
Beaten for the third time in a row. Length ball just outside off, Zadran pokes at it and gets beaten.
Beaten again! Similar delivery outside off, the batsman goes for a drive but gets beaten.
BEATEN! Taylor comes round the wicket. Bowls it on a length outside off. The batsman pokes at it and gets beaten.
Time to get underway! Javed Ahmadi and Noor Ali Zadran are the Afghan openers. It will be Jerome Taylor to kickoff proceedings with the ball. A slip in place. Here we go...
West Indies - Chadwick Walton(w), Evin Lewis, Marlon Samuels, Lendl Simmons, Carlos Brathwaite(c), Jason Mohammed, Rovman Powell, Sunil Narine, Jerome Taylor, Samuel Badree, Kesrick Williams.
Afghanistan - Gulbadin Naib, Noor Ali Zadran, Asghar Stanikzai(c), Javed Ahmadi, Mohammad Nabi, Karim Janat, Shafiqullah Shafiq(w), Najibullah Zadran, Rashid Khan, Amir Hamza, Shapoor Zadran.
TOSS - Afghanistan win the toss and elect to bat! There are two changes for them, Javed Ahmadi and Shapoor Zadran come in place of Samiullah Shenwari and Dawlat Zadran. West Indies are unchanged.

Afghanistan, on the other hand, were poor with the bat and the ball in the first two games. Their bowling attack has failed to get breakthroughs and their batting has failed to build partnerships. The visitors would have to up their game and give the Windies a run for their money. They would want to avoid a whitewash and get a morale-boosting victory ahead of the ODIs.

Hello and welcome to the third and final T20I between West Indies and Afghanistan at the Warner Park, Basseterre, St Kitts. This match between the two sides is a dead rubber as the Windies have already clinched the series. The home side, after dominating the first two games would be eyeing a whitewash over the Afghans. It has been a complete team effort from the hosts and they would look to end on a high.
